name: landing-page-copy
description: Use this skill when the user asks a design agent to write, revise, critique, or place landing page copy, hero copy, value proposition copy, CTA copy, sales page copy, signup/demo page copy, pricing page copy, or conversion-focused website sections. It teaches conversion copy judgment and directs the agent to fit the copy into the actual Hivy Canvas landing page design when a visual artifact is being created or edited.
human_description: Teach agents conversion-focused landing page copy for Canvas designs.
